result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: an invalid '-0%' discount badge on the pizza card in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second card under 'Popular right now' (pizza image) displays '-0%', which is meaningless and looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when there is no discount (0%) or display the correct non-zero discount value.
